items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 86:1
items.html: (To the question) Every degree needs anew Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin, both in the externality and in the internality, as is known. Therefore, although ZON were already completed in the degree of Chaya, at the Musaf of Shabbat, nevertheless, from the aspect of Yechida, they have still received nothing until Shabbat Mincha. And these Mochin of Mincha are only the aspect of the Neshama of the Yechida, which suffice only for the great ZON and Leah; but for the small ZON they do not suffice for the aspect of the GAR, but only for the aspect of VAK alone. Therefore they remained below, in the HGT of AA, and did not ascend with them to the GAR. And it is found that these Jacob and Rachel, who stand in the HGT of AA at the time of the ascent of ZON to the GAR of AA, are the Jacob and Rachel of the aspect of Yechida. And see above, Answer 215, where we explained another reason for why Rachel does not ascend to the GAR of AA; and both are true.
